{{Quote|I can take trouble if I have to. Thirty years back, you did my parents a big favor, and I’m happy to pay it back. I just want to keep my commission, too, if at all possible.|Davian to Garik Loran|<ref name="MK" />}}
'''Davian''' was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a naval [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> his parents owed [[Garik Loran|Garik "Face" Loran]] a favor, so Davian decided to pay Loran back by hacking into classified Galactic Alliance files in order to look into the disappearance of Alliance vessels. Davian's contribution to Loran's investigation was invaluable because it pointed to corrupt [[General/Legends|General]] [[Stavin Thaal]] as the culprit, who had already been under investigation by two [[Wraith Squadron]] units for his involvement with the [[Lecersen Conspiracy]].<ref name="MK" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|I am the living master of the database.|Davian|<ref name="MK" />}}
Davian was highly proficient in the use of cargo manifests and databases. He quickly recognized that a cargo manifest's primary and subfields had been mistakenly switched, correctly identifying Kuat as the true point of origin instead of Badfellow Station. He also demonstrated the ability to perform complex database searches and manipulate manifest data, including swapping primary and subfield entries to identify a pattern linking missing Galactic Alliance Navy cargo vessels to products manufactured by HyperTech Industries.<ref name="MK" />
